archetype: High-End Sneaker Tech (Mix of Archetype 5 Luxury & Archetype 2 Performance Pro)
design_philosophy: A 'Hypebeast Terminal'. It should feel like an elite command center for sneakerheads. Dark, high-contrast, data-dense but highly legible. The product is the hero, data is the weapon.

typography.setup_instructions: Import Outfit, IBM Plex Sans, and JetBrains Mono from Google Fonts. Assign 'font-sans' to IBM Plex Sans, 'font-heading' to Outfit, and 'font-mono' to JetBrains Mono in tailwind.config.js.

layout_and_spacing.strategy: Control Room Grid. High density for analytics, wide breathing room for product images.
layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Use Tailwind default spacing but favor generous padding (p-6, p-8) inside dashboard widgets to prevent clutter. For tight data rows, use py-2 px-4.
layout_and_spacing.dashboard_grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6. Dashboard widgets should use col-span variations to break monotony (e.g., Main Chart col-span-2 or 3, AI Feed col-span-1 row-span-2).
layout_and_spacing.corners: Rounded-lg (0.5rem) universally. Avoid excessive pill shapes unless for specific tags/badges.

surfaces_and_borders.cards: Solid flat background (bg-zinc-950), 1px crisp border (border-zinc-800). No soft drop shadows. Use subtle glow or translation on hover.
surfaces_and_borders.glassmorphism: Used ONLY for Sticky Nav or AI Chat modal. bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/10.
surfaces_and_borders.accents: For active price drops or hit targets, use a 1px solid primary (Volt) or accent (Red) border to draw attention immediately.
surfaces_and_borders.hover_states: Interactive elements must have distinct hover states. Elevate (-translate-y-0.5) and brighten border color.

components.buttons: Primary buttons: bg-primary text-black font-semibold hover:bg-[#B3E600]. Secondary: bg-transparent border border-zinc-700 text-white hover:bg-zinc-800.
components.badges: For stock status. 'In Stock': bg-primary/20 text-primary border border-primary/30. 'Out of Stock': bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-400. 'Discounted': bg-red-500/20 text-red-500 border border-red-500/30.
components.tables: Dense. border-collapse. border-b border-zinc-800 for rows. hover:bg-zinc-900/50. Numeric data must be tabular-nums right-aligned.
components.charts: Recharts or Shadcn Charts. Tooltips must have dark backgrounds and sharp borders. Lines should be 2px-3px thick, glowing if possible.
components.ai_chat: The 'AI Koç' (Coach) interface should look like a command-line terminal mixed with modern chat. Monospace fonts for debug/rules, normal fonts for chat.

icons.style: Duotone or Regular weight. Technical, clean, highly legible.

motion_and_interaction.loaders: Avoid generic spinners. Use highly technical loaders like a scanning line (Aceternity style) or an ASCII sneaker rendering.
motion_and_interaction.stagger: List items (products, alerts) should stagger in on load.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure all muted-foreground text passes minimum 4.5:1 ratio against the dark background. Use text-zinc-300 if zinc-400 is too dark.
accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: CRITICAL: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links, tabs) MUST include 'data-testid' in kebab-case representing their role. Example: data-testid='add-alert-button', data-testid='product-card-123'.

page_specific_guidelines.Dashboard_Ozet: Top area: 4 Metric cards (Total Tracked, Active Alerts, Price Drops Today, Scheduler Status). Middle: Large Price History Chart (Recharts) spanning 2 columns, next to 'Recent Alarms' feed.
page_specific_guidelines.Urunler_Listesi: Grid of products. Each card shows: Image, Brand/Model, Current Best Price, Target Price, Status Badge (Stock/Discount), and a mini sparkline chart of recent price.
page_specific_guidelines.AI_Arama: Zero-link search. A massive search input in the center of the page. Typing queries an API (mocked) and instantly shows a bento-grid of results parsed from various stores.
page_specific_guidelines.AI_Koc: A slide-out or full-page chat interface. User types 'Bana koşu için 3000 TL altı ayakkabı bul' (Find me running shoes under 3000 TL). AI responds with bento-style product suggestions inline in the chat.
page_specific_guidelines.Debug_Lab: A hacker-style terminal view. Monospace fonts. Shows raw JSON payloads, parser latency, and proxy status. Uses JetBrains Mono.
page_specific_guidelines.Ayarlar: Simple form inputs for Telegram Webhook URL, Cron job intervals. Use Shadcn Form, Input, Select, and Switch components.

implementation_notes.language: ALL TEXT IN THE UI MUST BE IN TURKISH (tr-TR). Example: 'Dashboard' -> 'Panel', 'Products' -> 'Ürünler', 'Settings' -> 'Ayarlar'.
implementation_notes.components_extension: Use .js or .jsx file extensions for React components. DO NOT use .tsx.
